text:
This looks like a few slices of seared steak with some rice grains and broccoli on a square plate about 26 cm across. The food covers roughly 10 cm by 10 cm, so the serving is small.

I count about 4-5 steak pieces, which I estimate at around 90 g. The rice, broccoli and sauce add roughly 30 g more, for a total of about 120 g.

Steak at about 200 kcal per 100 g gives roughly 180 kcal for the meat. The rice and sauce add roughly 50 kcal, so the total comes to about 230 kcal.
